scope.scopeNote: These are the 26 overlay/documentation capture profile entries in the current source inventory. They are not a complete enumeration of every public registry path.
scope.acceptanceNote: Source inspection only. No browser, OBS, public, or 104-case locale acceptance is claimed.

sharedI18nContract.precedence: URL ?lang takes precedence over localStorage app_locale; otherwise localStorage then default de.
sharedI18nContract.normalization: Language tags are reduced to their base language; unsupported values fall back to de.
sharedI18nContract.loader: GET /api/i18n/translations/{locale}; server merges root and plugin locale catalogs.
sharedI18nContract.socketSync: Only uses an existing window.socket when io is already present; late socket retry is limited to 20 attempts at 100 ms and is cancelled on non-persisted pagehide. Persisted pagehide preserves the BFCache document state.
sharedI18nContract.missingKeyBehavior: The client does not silently borrow English for a supported locale; data-i18n preserves its original fallback text, while t() can return the key unless the caller supplies its own fallback.
sharedI18nContract.coverageWarning: A locale query and four JSON files prove a loading path, not that every runtime string is translated or rendered in that language.

records.visibleTextExpectation: The title has a translation key. The canvas is empty and transparent before spawn; #perf-hud and #resolution-indicator are hidden by default. The renderer requests the read-only GET /api/emoji-rain/overlay/state, whose projection contains only opacity, and consumes emoji-rain:opacity events only when the payload contains exactly one finite numeric opacity in [0,1]. The current-state response is ignored if a valid opacity event arrived first. FPS/count/resolution diagnostics and effects are numeric/visual. The public registry allows this GET and the outgoing opacity event; the write-only POST opacity route is not a public overlay surface.
records.fonts: System font stack; local Matter.js and same-origin renderer scripts; no external font URL found.
